Card_TipSquelch: The receiver reports an open squelch
Card_TipMonitor: Play this radio's received audio on the PC
Card_TipKey: The PTT key transmits on this radio
Card_TipOnAir: The transmitter confirms that it is keyed
Card_TipPtt: Hold to transmit on this radio
Status_CallEnded: {0}: call ended by the radio or the network
Freq_HintLabel: Label only (this radio has no frequency control). Double-click to edit.
Freq_HintRead: Read from the radio. Double-click to change the frequency.
Freq_HintUnknown: The radio has not reported its frequency yet. Double-click to set it.
Freq_HintStale: Last known value, not confirmed by the radio yet. Double-click to change it.
Snmp_NoSuchObject: the radio does not provide this frequency object
Snmp_NotANumber: the answer is not a frequency ({0})
Snmp_TestNoTarget: Frequency control is switched off, or the address or the OID is missing.
Profile_NoteUntested: Not verified with real hardware. Implemented from the ED-137 interoperability standard; check the log window if the radio rejects the call.
Set_TipUp: Move the selected radio earlier in the display order
Set_TipDown: Move the selected radio later in the display order
Set_BalanceNote: Balance lets you hear one radio in the left ear and another in the right ear of a stereo headset.
Set_SnmpUnit: How the radio reports the frequency
Set_SnmpTxOid: Frequency OID of the transmitter (empty = same)
Set_SnmpRxHost: SNMP address of the receiver (empty = RX IP address)
Set_SnmpTxHost: SNMP address of the transmitter (empty = TX IP address)
Set_SnmpRadioHost: SNMP address of the radio (empty = its IP address)
Set_SnmpNote: Take the object identifier (OID) and the number format from the documentation of your radio. The community needs write access to change the frequency.
Set_SipLogin: SIP login (only if the radio asks for one)
Set_SipPassword: SIP password (stored in config.json as text)
Ptt_CaptureHint: Press the key to use (Esc cancels)
Ptt_KeyNote: The key works while another program is in front or this program is minimised. It transmits on every connected radio whose KEY switch is on.
Ptt_HideKey: Hide the PTT key from other programs
Ptt_HideKeyNote: Use this when the key would otherwise type or trigger something in the program in front. While this program runs, the key does nothing else.
Ptt_Limit: Transmit time limit in seconds (0 = no limit)
Ptt_LimitNote: Protects the frequency from a stuck key: the transmission is stopped and resumes only after the key was released.
Ptt_SingleTx: Only one radio transmits at a time
Ptt_ArbitrationLabel: When several radios are keyed together
Arb_First: First wins - the radio already transmitting keeps the channel
Arb_Last: Last wins - the most recent press takes over
Arb_Priority: Priority - the first radio in the list wins
Audio_DeviceNote: A device that is unplugged later falls back to the Windows default and is logged. Volume and left/right balance are set per radio on the Radios tab.
Nr_Strong: Strong - about 18 dB quieter, speech may sound thinner
Audio_NrNote: Turns down steady noise around the microphone (engines, wind, fans). Rumble below the voice band is always removed. Listen to the result on a second receiver before relying on it.
Audio_Gate: Noise gate: send clean silence while nobody speaks
Audio_GateNote: The beginning of a word is kept when the gate opens. Turn the gate off if quiet speech is still cut.
Audio_LeadNote: The transmitter is keyed this long before your voice is sent; what you say meanwhile is delayed, not lost. Raise it if the first syllable is missing on the receiving side, lower it for less delay.
Audio_TailNote: The transmitter stays keyed this long after the last word was sent. Raise it if the end of a transmission is cut.
Gen_LanguageNote: Translations were made by machine and may contain mistakes. English is the reference.
View_Classic: Classic - tall cards, two per column
View_Grid: Grid - square tiles, four per row
Gen_OnTop: Keep the window on top of other programs
Gen_AutoReconnect: Reconnect automatically when a call drops or fails
Gen_ConnectOnStartup: Connect all radios when the program starts
Pin_NotSet: No PIN is set; anyone can open the settings.
Gen_PinNote: The PIN keeps settings from being changed by accident. It is not a security barrier: anyone who can edit config.json can remove it.

Val_Tail: The hold time after speech must be 0 to {0} milliseconds.
